name: io.github.christophe77/netatmo-energy-mcp
title: Netatmo Energy
description: MCP server for Netatmo thermostats and radiator valves: status, history, analytics, opt-in control.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Netatmo app client ID. Optional after running `npx -y netatmo-energy-mcp login`, which stores it.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Netatmo app client secret. Optional after `login`, which stores it locally.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level written to stderr: debug, info, warn, error or silent.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to force read-only mode. Write mode is only possible after `login --write`.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: Write mode: 'elicitation' only accepts confirmations shown by the MCP client (default 'auto').

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_MIN_TEMP
environmentVariables.description: Write mode: lowest temperature a change may set, in °C (default 7).

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_MAX_TEMP
environmentVariables.description: Write mode: highest temperature a change may set, in °C (default 28).

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_MAX_SETPOINT_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Write mode: longest manual room setpoint, in hours (default 24).
